title: X API
subtitle: An in-house X integration where one service owns the rate limit, the monthly budget and the send log, and never re-sends an action whose outcome is unknown.

stats.label: action tools, each with an inverse

lede: FAFOHive needed an X integration that AI agents could use for research and replies without burning a metered budget or posting twice. I built it behind the same governed tool gateway as every other tool, with the same identity, attribution and audit, on two programmatic routes: the official X API v2, and a third-party X data API that costs less for public research. A third route, the operator's own signed-in session, covers actions the official API does not allow here. The official API goes through an allow-listed transport with OAuth 2.0 and PKCE for user context, and its Activity webhooks are checked before ingestion. Routing is fixed per action, chosen from measured platform behaviour.
quote: A duplicated public post is worse than a missing one.
evidence: Tool synthesis and governed API integration: an X integration of 36 tools, 21 for reading and 15 for actions, with read and act on separately authorised endpoints.
Rate limiting and budget control: one service owns the rate limit, a monthly budget with reservations and a durable send log, and every result states its cost.
Exactly-once delivery: every write read back, and a write whose outcome is unknown never resent automatically.
author: Corey James
